title: Homepage post cards display reading time
description: Verifies that the homepage latest posts list includes reading time on each visible post card.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the latest posts list is displayed
Verify each visible post card shows a reading time value

title: Dark theme styling is applied on initial load
description: Verifies that the homepage loads with dark theme styling applied and not as unstyled content.
category: Dark theme UI and responsive layout

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the page uses a dark theme appearance
Verify the layout is styled and readable

title: Post page includes required SEO meta and canonical tags
description: This test verifies that a post page includes core SEO metadata (title/description), Open Graph/Twitter tags, and a canonical URL link in the document head.

steps.description: Navigate to /blog/2026/04/seo-en-2026
Verify the page includes meta title and meta description
Verify Open Graph, Twitter card, and canonical link tags are present

title: Search returns results and opens a post
description: Verifies that opening header search lazy-loads Pagefind and a user can search and open a result that renders as a post page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the header search toggle
Fill a common keyword into the search field
Click the first search result
Verify an individual blog post page is displayed
Verify the post content is rendered

title: Open a tag page from the homepage tag cloud
description: This test verifies that a reader can navigate from the homepage tag cloud to a tag-filtered listing and see posts displayed for that tag.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a tag link in the tag cloud
Verify the tag-filtered posts listing is displayed
Verify at least one post is displayed in the listing

title: Individual post page displays reading time
description: Verifies that a user can open a post and see a reading time value on the post page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the first post card in the latest posts list
Verify an individual blog post page is displayed
Verify a reading time value is displayed on the post page

title: CSS asset endpoint is reachable
description: Verifies that the compiled stylesheet can be requested successfully to prevent unstyled UI in normal browsing.
category: Dark theme UI and responsive layout

steps.description: Navigate to /assets/styles.css
Verify the stylesheet content is displayed as a CSS file

title: View posts for a specific tag via direct tag route
description: This test verifies that visiting a known tag route shows a list of posts that match the selected tag.

steps.description: Navigate to /tag/astro
Verify the tag page is displayed
Verify at least one post is displayed in the listing

title: Post page includes JSON-LD Article structured data
description: This test verifies that a post page includes JSON-LD structured data describing the article for search engines.

steps.description: Navigate to /blog/2026/04/seo-en-2026
Verify JSON-LD structured data for an Article is present
Verify the post page content is displayed

title: Sitemap index includes homepage and blog listing URLs
description: Verifies that the sitemap index includes entries for core listing routes such as the homepage and blog index.

steps.description: Navigate to /sitemap-index.xml
Verify the sitemap includes an entry for the homepage and a blog listing page

title: Sticky header remains available after scrolling
description: Verifies that the header remains accessible after scrolling down the homepage to support navigation and search.
category: Dark theme UI and responsive layout

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll down near the bottom of the page
Verify the header is still visible and usable

title: Tag cloud displays tag names and counts
description: This test verifies that the homepage tag cloud displays tags with visible counts and that each tag is presented as a navigable link.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify a tag cloud is displayed
Verify tag entries show both a tag name and a count and are presented as links

title: RSS feed is accessible and contains post entries
description: Verifies that the RSS feed can be opened and returns an RSS XML document that includes item entries for posts.

steps.description: Navigate to /rss.xml
Verify an RSS XML document is displayed
Verify the feed contains multiple item entries

title: RSS feed includes valid post links
description: Verifies that the RSS feed contains clickable links that point to post pages under the blog path.

steps.description: Navigate to /rss.xml
Click the first feed item link
Verify a blog post page is displayed

title: Sitemap index is accessible and is valid XML
description: Verifies that the sitemap index page can be opened and displays an XML sitemap index document.

steps.description: Navigate to /sitemap-index.xml
Verify an XML sitemap index document is displayed

title: Archive page shows posts grouped by year
description: This test verifies that the archive page renders a chronological index grouped by year with posts listed under year headings.

steps.description: Navigate to /blog/archivo
Verify the archive page is displayed
Verify posts are grouped under year headings

title: Search supports an empty query result state
description: Verifies that searching for a nonsense term shows a clear no-results state without breaking the page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the header search toggle
Fill a gibberish term into the search field
Verify an empty search results state is displayed
Verify the search UI remains usable

title: Archive page allows opening a post from a year group
description: This test verifies that a reader can open an individual post by clicking a post entry from the archive index.

steps.description: Navigate to /blog/archivo
Click a post link within a year group
Verify an individual post page is displayed
Verify the post content is displayed

title: Subscriber can submit a valid email from the footer newsletter form
description: Verifies that entering a valid email in the footer newsletter form and submitting shows a success confirmation in the UI.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the footer
Fill user@example.com into the newsletter email field
Submit the newsletter form
Verify a subscription success confirmation is visible

title: Return to the homepage after viewing a tag page
description: This test verifies that a reader can return to the homepage from a tag listing using normal in-app navigation.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a tag link in the tag cloud
Click the site logo or home link in the header
Verify the user lands on the homepage
Verify the latest posts section is displayed

title: Sitemap index contains multiple URL entries
description: Verifies that the sitemap index includes more than one URL entry, indicating broad coverage of site pages.

steps.description: Navigate to /sitemap-index.xml
Verify the sitemap contains multiple URL entries

title: Search UI can be opened and closed without losing page context
description: Verifies that the search overlay/panel can be toggled on and off and the user returns to normal page browsing.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the header search toggle
Click the header search toggle again
Verify the search UI is no longer visible
Verify the homepage content is still displayed

title: Newsletter form blocks invalid email with client-side validation
description: Verifies that submitting the newsletter form with an invalid email shows a validation error and does not show a success confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the footer
Fill invalid-email into the newsletter email field
Submit the newsletter form
Verify an email validation error is visible

title: Post with missing frontmatter degrades gracefully in SEO output
description: This test verifies that a post page with missing required frontmatter still renders while showing observable missing SEO elements rather than breaking the page.

steps.description: Navigate to /blog/bad-frontmatter
Verify the post page content is displayed
Verify expected SEO elements such as canonical and Open Graph image are not present

title: Show empty state for a tag with no posts
description: This test verifies that visiting a tag page with no published posts shows an empty-state message rather than a broken or blank page.

steps.description: Navigate to /tag/unused-tag
Verify an empty state message is visible
Verify no posts are displayed in the listing

title: RSS feed provides a stable empty-state behavior when no items are visible
description: Verifies that if the RSS feed renders without visible items, the page still displays a valid RSS XML document rather than a blank page.

steps.description: Navigate to /rss.xml
Verify an RSS XML document is displayed

title: Dev-mode search shows an informative message when the index is missing
description: Verifies that when the Pagefind index is not present, opening search shows an informative dev-mode message instead of a broken UI.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the header search toggle
Verify an informative message about the missing search index is displayed

title: Newsletter form prevents submission when email is empty
description: Verifies that submitting the newsletter form with an empty email shows a required-field validation error.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the footer
Clear the newsletter email field
Submit the newsletter form
Verify a required email validation error is visible

title: Malformed post does not show a valid reading time
description: Verifies that a known malformed post renders but indicates a missing or zero reading time value rather than showing an incorrect normal value.

steps.description: Navigate to /blog/broken-post
Verify an individual blog post page is displayed
Verify the reading time value is missing or zero
